HOOLHEYAKMOD-ANALYSIS.title: Analysis
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ANALYSIS.description: A value used to enhance specific effects.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-MEANDER.title: Meander
HOOLHEYAKMOD-MEANDER.description: For every 5 Skills you play (the default on Standard difficulty), deal 3 damage and apply 1 [gold]Lift[/gold] to a random enemy. Hits a number of times equal to your [gold]Analysis[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ERUDITION.title: Erudition
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ERUDITION.description: For every 4 Attacks you play (the default on Standard difficulty), deal damage equal to your [gold]Analysis[/gold] and apply 1 [gold]Lift[/gold] to a random enemy. Hits 4 times.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-GRAVITY.title: Gravity
HOOLHEYAKMOD-GRAVITY.description: An inherent enemy attribute equal to 10% of its Max HP (rounded down, minimum 1). When [gold]Lift[/gold] reaches this value, trigger [gold]Levitation[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-LIFT.title: Lift
HOOLHEYAKMOD-LIFT.description: When its stacks reach [gold]Gravity[/gold], remove all stacks and trigger [gold]Levitation[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-LEVITATION.title: Levitation
HOOLHEYAKMOD-LEVITATION.description:
Lose all [gold]Block[/gold] and gain 20 [gold]Deconstruction[/gold]. Take 50% more damage and deal 70% less damage.
At the end of the turn, take ([gold]Gravity[/gold] + [gold]Lift[/gold]) × 2 damage, then remove this status and all [gold]Lift[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-WEIGHTLESSNESS.title: Weightless
HOOLHEYAKMOD-WEIGHTLESSNESS.description: Receive twice as much [gold]Lift[/gold]. At the end of the turn, lose 1 stack.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-VARIABLE.title: Variable
HOOLHEYAKMOD-VARIABLE.description: When the conditions on the card are met, choose one of the listed effects to activate.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-DECONSTRUCTION.title: Deconstruction
HOOLHEYAKMOD-DECONSTRUCTION.description: Whenever you gain [gold]Block[/gold], consume an equal number of stacks to negate the [gold]Block[/gold] gained.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-PHASE.title: Aspect
HOOLHEYAKMOD-PHASE.description: Ho'olheyak's field effect. Triggering a new [gold]Aspect[/gold] replaces your current one. Each Ho'olheyak can have only 1 at a time. Effects on allies apply only to the Aspect's owner.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BENEFIC_PHASE.title: Benefic Aspect
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BENEFIC_PHASE.description: An [gold]Aspect[/gold] that favors beneficial effects or opportunities for combos.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-MALEFIC_PHASE.title: Malefic Aspect
HOOLHEYAKMOD-MALEFIC_PHASE.description: An [gold]Aspect[/gold] with severe drawbacks or exceptionally high risk.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-NEUTRAL_PHASE.title: Neutral
HOOLHEYAKMOD-NEUTRAL_PHASE.description: An [gold]Aspect[/gold] with double-edged effects or changes to fundamental rules.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-SLOUGH.title: Slough
HOOLHEYAKMOD-SLOUGH.description: Triggers an additional effect while you have a debuff.
